name: Mirror of the Star-Fallen Lake (Tinh Lạc Kính)
lore: A disc of black stone polished flat and set in a bronze rim, cut in 160 from the bed of Tinh Lạc Hồ where the lake holds the Dipper at night (A205). Laid on the water, it shows the stars as the lake sees them. Thẩm Bắc Thần has carried it for six hundred years.
build_use: The head's divination piece: thần thức, Earth stacks, and a ward against the first blow.

name: Ring of the Armillary (Tuyền Cơ Hoàn)
lore: A ring of Vẫn Tinh star iron cut from the spare outer circle when the armillary was finished in 180 (C055). It is given to the keeper of the Tuyền Cơ Nghi, who winds it each dusk. Tô Tinh Nghi has worn it since 1090.
build_use: The armillary keeper's ring: longer Earth stacks and longer arrays.

name: Flag of the Turning Dipper (Chuyển Đẩu Trận Kỳ)
lore: Seven small flags on one staff, which the head plants and turns a seventh of a circle each night as the Dipper turns.
build_use: Earth stacks that last: the field that turns around him.

name: Flag of the Ecliptic (Hoàng Đạo Kỳ)
lore: A ring of twelve pennants that marks the sun's road; the prioress plants it inside her first ring to lay the second.
build_use: Ring damage and the second ring on the first.

name: Robe of the Armillary Keeper (Tuyền Cơ Bào)
lore: Brass-grey, cut to work in the armillary hall's cold all night; the sleeves are bound so they never catch on a moving ring.
build_use: Guard and linh lực for the keeper who holds the rings.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
